sermon.title: Immune System 03/29/2020
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: Preached as the coronavirus spread, this message compares the body’s immune system to a spiritual one. Some, like Asa, turned to physicians alone; Hezekiah and David turned to God. Lies spread like a virus, but believers have authority over the enemy and must put on the armor of God, walk in the Spirit, and return to God in prayer and fasting.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: Did God hear Hezekiah?
faqs.answer: Yes. God said, I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears.

faqs.question: What authority does Luke 10:19 give?
faqs.answer: Authority to trample on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy.
